profile.aboutStory:
I'm Subeko Pio, a software engineer based in Kampala, Uganda. I discovered programming through curiosity about how apps work—and never looked back.

Today I focus on full-stack development: React and Next.js on the front, Node.js and PostgreSQL on the back. I enjoy turning complex problems into simple, maintainable systems.

When I'm not coding, I'm learning new tools, contributing to open source, or mentoring junior developers. I'm always open to roles and projects where I can ship meaningful products.
